title: Check rustfmt in Rust CI
why: Without a checked formatting gate, style drift creates avoidable review noise and inconsistent generated patches.
suggestion: Run cargo fmt --all -- --check in a checked-in CI workflow.
limitations: Only checked-in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure Pipelines, and Jenkins files are inspected.
Pre-commit hooks delegated to matching Makefile targets are resolved; reusable workflows, aliases, and other shell wrappers are not.
